props.title: What Is Cellulite Massage?
props.text: Cellulite massage is a firm, targeted body massage that can temporarily improve the look of uneven skin texture associated with cellulite. Your therapist works on the areas where cellulite often shows, such as the thighs, hips, buttocks and abdomen, and adjusts the intensity to your comfort.
props.feature1Text: Commonly focuses on the thighs, hips, buttocks and abdomen.
props.feature2Text: Firm, controlled movements that stay within your comfort.

props.title: Treatment Duration & Pricing
props.text: Choose the length by how many areas you want treated: 1 hour suits one or two areas, and 2 hours covers all the main ones.

props.title: What Causes Cellulite
props.text: Cellulite develops when fat deposits beneath the skin push against connective tissue, creating the uneven or dimpled appearance many people notice on the thighs, hips, or buttocks. Common factors linked to it:
featuresLeft: Can affect people of different body types
Often influenced by genetics and hormones
featuresRight: May become more visible with fluid retention
Frequently associated with connective tissue structure
A very common and normal skin condition

props.title: What Cellulite Massage Can Do
props.text: Cellulite massage uses focused pressure and rhythmic movements on the areas where cellulite usually shows. Why guests choose it:
featuresLeft: Leaves the skin feeling warm and smooth
Firm, rhythmic strokes that feel invigorating
Legs and hips can feel lighter afterwards
featuresRight: Fits into a regular body-care routine

props.title: How the Treatment Works
props.text: Your therapist works on the areas you choose, at an intensity that stays comfortable. Each session includes:
featuresLeft: Focused work on selected body zones
featuresRight: Available at the spa or through home service

items.question: Which areas does a cellulite massage treat?
items.answer: Cellulite massage at Spa Bali Moon commonly focuses on the thighs, hips, buttocks and abdomen, although other areas may be included depending on your goals. Your therapist confirms the areas with you first. A 1-hour session suits one or two areas, and 2 hours covers all the main areas.

items.question: Does a cellulite massage remove cellulite permanently?
items.answer: No. Cellulite massage at Spa Bali Moon is not a permanent solution. Regular sessions can temporarily improve the look of skin texture; results build gradually and fade once you stop.

items.question: How is a cellulite massage different from a lymphatic massage?
items.answer: Cellulite massage uses firmer, more targeted techniques that focus on the look of skin texture, mainly on the thighs, hips, buttocks and abdomen. Lymphatic massage uses much lighter, rhythmic movements and feels gentler and more relaxing. Spa Bali Moon offers both in Seminyak.

items.question: Is a cellulite massage painful?
items.answer: It should not be. Cellulite massage at Spa Bali Moon uses firmer pressure than a relaxing Balinese massage, but it should remain comfortable throughout the session. Your therapist adjusts the intensity to your comfort level and can change the pressure at any time, so tell them if it feels too strong.

items.question: How many cellulite massage sessions do I need?
items.answer: There is no fixed number. Many guests book regular sessions over several weeks, because results build gradually and are temporary. At Spa Bali Moon, your therapist can help you plan sessions around your comfort and goals.

items.question: Who is a cellulite massage for?
items.answer: It suits adults who want a firm, focused massage on the thighs, hips, buttocks or abdomen, especially those who would like to soften the look of cellulite there for a while. It also suits anyone who simply enjoys firm pressure on specific areas.

items.question: What is the difference between cellulite and stretch marks?
items.answer: Cellulite and stretch marks are different skin concerns. Cellulite gives skin a dimpled or uneven look, commonly on the thighs, buttocks, hips and abdomen. Stretch marks are lines or streaks from skin stretching or changing rapidly, often during growth, weight changes or pregnancy. Spa Bali Moon's cellulite massage focuses on cellulite and does not remove stretch marks.

items.question: How much does a cellulite massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: Cellulite massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 350.000 for 1 hour, IDR 520.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 695.000 for 2 hours per person. Longer sessions allow more time across multiple areas. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Book on WhatsApp from 9am to 11pm.

items.question: How long does a cellulite massage take?
items.answer: A cellulite massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 1 hour (IDR 350.000), 1.5 hours (IDR 520.000) or 2 hours (IDR 695.000) per person. Longer sessions give more time across several areas.

items.question: Can I have a cellulite massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen, oils and everything a cellulite massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta.

items.question: Can I book a cellulite massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my cellulite massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your cellulite massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
